Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add modern UI builders for Auth, Onboarding, and Settings scenes

- Create LoginUIBuilder with premium CYAN neon design
- Create RegisterUIBuilder with consistent Auth theme
- Update AgeVerificationUIBuilder to GOLD premium theme
- Create OnboardingUIBuilder with 5 slides and numbered badges
- Create CashBattleOnboardingUIBuilder with GOLD theme emphasizing real money
- Add CashBattleOnboardingManager for slide navigation
- Create OnboardingSlidePreview tool for editor testing
- Add SettingsUIBuilder with card-based modern design
- Create BackButton utilities and auto-adder for navigation
- Move Onboarding scenes to dedicated folder structure

All builders follow modern gaming UI patterns with neon themes,
card-based layouts, and consistent CYAN/GOLD color schemes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
V1 Release: Remove BattlePass/Chests, add Auto Assigners system

Major changes for V1 release:
- Remove BattlePass system \(scenes, scripts, prefabs, icons\)
- Remove ChestOpening system completely
- Update Achievements from 58 to 53 \(remove Collector category\)
- Fix namespace conflict \(DigitPark.Debug -> DigitPark.DevTools\)

New Auto Assigners system:
- BaseReferenceAssigner: Common helper methods
- AchievementsReferenceAssigner: Auto-assign scene references
- AchievementIconAssigner: Map icons to achievement IDs

AchievementsUIBuilder improvements:
- Add Slider components for progress bars
- Add EmptyStateContainer for no-results view
- Add CanvasGroup to DetailPanel for animations

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
